title: Binance Traders League Season 2: Compete in the Regional Competitions and Win a Share of $100,000 in BNB!
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To create a more exciting and competitive trading tournament, Binance is excited to introduce the  first-ever regional competitions  in Binance Traders League Season 2! Join now, compete as a team, and represent your region to vie for the top prize. Become a top trader in your region and claim your share of  $100,000 in BNB token voucher rewards ! Activity Period:  2025-06-09 00:00 (UTC) to 2025-07-06 23:59 (UTC) User Eligibility : All verified  regular  and  VIP 1-6 users , excluding liquidity providers. How to Join: Click the  [Join Now]   button on the  landing page  to automatically register with a regional team based on your KYC location. Compete for the highest  Regional Team ROI (Return on Investment)*  by representing your regions in the  Spot Regional ROI Competition  and/or  Futures Regional ROI Competition , subject to eligibility based on your country or region of residence. Individual traders will also be ranked within their own regional teams, based on their Spot ROI and/or Futures ROI from trading eligible trading pairs during the Activity Period. The respective rankings will be reflected on the Spot and/or Futures Regional ROI Competition leaderboards. Notes :   *Regional Team ROI  = Mean ROI of top 100 regional team members ranked by the ROI (ROI >0) in that region.  For details on how to calculate the ROI of individual traders in the Spot and/or Futures Regional ROI Competition(s), please refer to the formula in  this landing page . Rewards Structure: Spot ROI Regional Competition: Share $30,000 in BNB Rewards! Within the  regional team that attains the   highest Regional Team ROI  after the Activity Period, the  top 100 qualified traders*  with the highest Spot ROI from trading eligible trading pairs during the Activity Period will qualify to share  $25,000 in BNB token vouchers  based   on the reward calculation formula below. The reward for the top 100 traders is  capped at $500 in BNB token voucher each . In addition, among the remaining regional teams, the  top 10 qualified traders*  with the highest Spot ROI from trading eligible trading pairs during the Activity Period will qualify to share  $5,000 in BNB token vouchers  based   on the reward calculation formula below. The reward for these traders is capped at  $150 in BNB token voucher   each .  Notes:  Reward Calculation : The reward for each qualified trader = (Each trader’s Spot ROI/ Sum of all qualified traders’ Spot ROI) * Rewards Pool *Users must trade  at least $1,000 equivalent  in total eligible Spot trading volume  and  achieve a  positive ROI of at least 5%  during the Activity Period to qualify for any rewards under the Spot ROI Regional Competition. Futures ROI Regional Competition: Share $70,000 in BNB Rewards! Within the  regional team that attains the highest Regional Team ROI  after the Activity Period, the  top 100 qualified traders**  with the  highest Futures ROI  during the Activity Period will qualify to share  $50,000 in BNB token vouchers  based on the reward calculation formula below. The reward for the top 100 traders is  capped at $1,000 in BNB token voucher each . In addition, among the remaining regional teams, the  top 10 qualified traders**  with the  highest Futures ROI  during the Activity Period will qualify to share  $20,000 in BNB token vouchers  based on the reward calculation formula below. The reward for these traders is  capped at $800 in BNB token voucher each . Notes:  Reward Calculation : The reward for each qualified trader = (Each trader’s Futures ROI/ Sum of all qualified traders’ Futures ROI) * Rewards Pool **Users must trade  at least $1,000 equivalent  in total across any Binance USDⓈ-M and COIN-M contracts,  and  achieved a  positive ROI of at least 5%  during the Activity Period to be eligible for any rewards under the Futures ROI Regional Competition. Lead Your Region to Glory & Claim Your Share of $100K in BNB! Terms & Conditions: These terms and conditions (“Activity Terms”) govern users’ participation in the Binance Traders League Season 2 Regional Competitions (“Activity”). By participating in this Activity, users agree to these Activity Terms, and the following additional terms: (a)  Binance Terms and Conditions for Prize Promotions ; (b)  Binance Terms of Use ; and (c)  Binance Privacy Notice ; all of which are incorporated by reference into these terms and conditions.  In the case of any inconsistency or conflict between these Activity Terms, and any other incorporated terms, the provisions of these Activity Terms shall prevail, followed by the  following in this order of precedence, and to the extent of such conflict: (a)  Binance Terms and Conditions for Prize Promotions ; (b)  Binance Terms of Use ; and (c)  Binance Privacy Notice . ​​Only users from qualified regions who  complete account verification (KYC)  shall be eligible for any rewards. All promotions (and associated trading pairs) including the Activity are only available to users who are eligible for Binance Spot and/or Futures trading (as the case may be) and may not be available or may be restricted in certain jurisdictions or regions or to certain users, depending on legal and regulatory requirements. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance trading services as well as Binance Spot and/or Futures trading pairs, in each country/region from which the services are accessed. The graphics displayed in the landing page are solely for illustrative purposes. All references to “$” represent the United States Dollar unless otherwise specified. “ROI” stands for Return on Investment.  The spot trading volume of all  USD stablecoin trading pairs with zero trading fees , as well as any other trading pairs with  zero trading fees , will be excluded from final calculations of users’ spot trading volumes.  If multiple users attain the same ROI for the Spot and/or Futures Regional ROI Competition(s) at the end of the Activity Period, they will be ranked by their respective Spot and/or Futures trading volume as the secondary criteria. Reward Distribution:  Rewards will be distributed in the form of token vouchers within  21 days  after the Activity concludes. Winners will be able to log in and redeem their voucher rewards via Profile >  Rewards Hub .  All voucher rewards will expire within  two weeks  after distribution. Eligible users should claim their vouchers before the expiration date.  Learn how to redeem a voucher . Non-Binance users may  click here  to register for a Binance account and get a 10% spot trading fee discount upon successful registration. The 10% spot trading fee discount will remain valid as long as the Binance referral program is in place.   Binance reserves the right to disqualify any participants who tamper with Binance program code, or interfere with the operation of Binance program code with other software. Binance further reserves the right to disqualify a user’s reward eligibility if the account is involved in any dishonest behavior (e.g., wash trading, illegally bulk account registrations, risk accounts, self dealing, or market manipulation). Sub-account’s trading volume will not be combined with the master account’s standard trading volume in the final calculation. Each sub-account will not be viewed as an independent account when participating in this Activity. Binance reserves the right at any time in its sole and absolute discretion to determine and/or amend or vary these Activity Terms without prior notice, including but not limited to canceling, extending, terminating or suspending this Activity, its eligibility terms and criteria, the selection and number of winners, and the timing of any act to be done, and all users shall be bound by these amendments.
